ns2:course.label: Business Planning in Audiology
ns2:course.description: Provides graduate students with an overview of the business planning and management aspects of audiology. Students will learn about the tools needed to start or purchase a practice and understand the economics of audiology. The concepts discussed in this course will be relevant to a variety of audiology employment settings, including private practice. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Restricted to graduate students.
